title: Which way do cricket pitches face?
excerpt: The old advice says a cricket pitch should run north to south, out of the evening sun. I measured every cricket pitch in OpenStreetMap and every sports pitch in the UK: 55% of cricket strips follow the rule, tennis courts mostly do, and football pitches point anywhere.
seo_description: 55% of the world's mapped cricket strips run north to south. Tennis follows the rule; football ignores it.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Which way do cricket pitches face?' on parchment beside a large rose diagram of cricket strips standing upright on the north to south line, with the line '55% lie within 20° of N to S'.
